{{Quote|The detention center's warden says my old squad-mates are serving life sentences.|Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="The Surgeons" />}}
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Berrun detention center|detention facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berrun]] was run by a '''warden''' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="The Surgeons" /> Around [[3641 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|3}}</ref> [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] contacted the [[Warden/Legends|warden]] in order to confirm rumors that the members of his first command were [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] at the Berrun facility, and the prison official informed the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] that his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] had in fact been incarcerated in the facility after they began targeting the families of enemy [[Commander/Legends|commanders]]. The [[Republic Special Forces Division]] had been forced to arrest the squad, which was part of its [[Special Forces black ops program|black ops program]]. The [[Surgeons]], as the squad had been known, was convicted of war crimes and imprisoned under life sentences, and the warden conveyed that information and the fact that the squad was proud of their actions to Rusk when contacted.<ref name="The Surgeons" />

==Behind the scenes==
The prison Warden was first mentioned during the conversation "The Surgeons" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character Fideltin Rusk, in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="The Surgeons" />
